split_rule: Critical-phase items split at the tau = 0.1 groupthink boundary (low = trust < boundary, high = trust >= boundary). This is the paper's documented operating point, not a parameter tuned to the labels.
supersedes: The earlier uncommitted low-trust 71.4% (N=21) / high-trust 27.3% (N=11) percentages, whose bucket correct counts (15 + 3 = 18) were inconsistent with the committed 20/32 critical aggregate. Sample sizes are unchanged (N=21 / N=11); only the percentages are corrected to their reproducible values (CAB-04).
limitations: Small sample: 32 critical items total; treat as a directional finding.
Correctness label is majority_correct from the committed N500 artifact.
